description: Quick look at what's arrived: lists recent inbox messages across all mailboxes (or one), newest first, with a short preview. Best tool for "has anything come in today?" or "any new emails in the support inbox?".

account.description: Mailbox to check. Leave out (or use "all") to check every mailbox.

limit.description: Maximum messages per mailbox. Defaults to 15.

since.description: Only messages received on or after this date: "today", "yesterday", "7d" or a date like 2026-11-01.

unread_only.description: Only show unread messages. Defaults to true.

name: check_inbox
title: Check inbox
